title: Writing / Style / Phone numbers
slide_intent: Give phone numbers a consistent visible structure so readers can group and copy the digits easily.
strategic_value: A single accepted pattern can help Duolingo avoid inconsistent punctuation in contact details.
demonstration: A checked phone-number example uses three digit groups separated by hyphens.
practical_value: Use the displayed hyphenated pattern for the guide’s phone-number convention.

content_islands.spec: Place the topic heading, its parent label and the written convention in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Place the worked copy in the pale right panel, keeping preference labels and green checks with their examples.

reference_purposes.Application: The displayed example is 555-123-4567; it illustrates the stated punctuation convention without defining international numbering rules.

ingredient.name: Phone numbers convention
ingredient.role: Readers can group and copy the digits easily.
